summary: No advisory committee was convened for BLA761149 (Enspryng/satralizumab-mwge). The Summary Review states the application was not referred to an advisory committee because the safety profile was similar to other biologics with similar mechanisms, the trial designs were acceptable, and the efficacy findings were clear; the Medical Review likewise states an advisory committee meeting was not recommended. Because no committee met, there are no AdComm-driven linkages to the approval.
